items.description: Report does not state whether a real griefing transaction was observed; the bundle-revert impact is described as potential, so the relation is a safety obligation rather than an observed event.
Whether the validation revert actually propagates to handleOps depends on EntryPoint version and bundler implementation, which the report leaves unspecified.
Report describes bundler disruption impacts as potential; no observed griefing transaction or concrete retry/blacklisting outcome is stated, so the disruption observable is a qualitative Boolean.
Whether the validation revert propagates to handleOps and causes bundler simulation failure depends on EntryPoint version and bundler implementation, which the report does not fix.
Report describes the wallet-degradation impact as potential and does not state an observed griefing transaction or a concrete threshold for bundler deprioritization.
